title: GOTV broadcast definitions (proposed by Ready Up, docs/design/tv-plugin.md)

broadcastProfile.description: The tv plugin's GOTV profile (match.assign config.rules.broadcast, cmd tv.set settings). Every key optional; absent = the server's setting. Must not disagree with config.cvars (invalid_config).

delay_seconds.description: tv_delay. Never below the match's own minimum (config.cvars.tv_delay, rules.overrides.tv_delay, 105 under ruleset valve): match.assign is refused (invalid_config) when it is lower

allow_insecure_observers.description: true: tv_secure_bypass 1 + sv_deltaticks_enforce 0 (observers with an insecure client, e.g. HLAE / Lexogrine HUD Manager, may watch over GOTV; the game port stays VAC-secured). false: tv_secure_bypass 0, sv_deltaticks_enforce back to its value before

broadcastSettings.description: cmd tv.set args.settings: like broadcastProfile, null = back to the default (server: tv.cfg; match: the match's rules.broadcast)

oneOf.description: tv_delay. Never below the match's own minimum (config.cvars.tv_delay, rules.overrides.tv_delay, 105 under ruleset valve): match.assign is refused (invalid_config) when it is lower

true: tv_secure_bypass 1 + sv_deltaticks_enforce 0 (observers with an insecure client, e.g. HLAE / Lexogrine HUD Manager, may watch over GOTV; the game port stays VAC-secured). false: tv_secure_bypass 0, sv_deltaticks_enforce back to its value before

tvState.description: GOTV state of the server (hello.tv, state.snapshot.tv, server.tv). Engine values are what the server read back (null = not read / unknown). Never contains the GOTV password.

available.description: false: tv.so is loaded but tv.cfg enabled=0 (it touches nothing)

port.description: GOTV port (+tv_port, else the tv_port cvar)

clients.description: GOTV spectators on this server (tv_status); null = not read yet

password_set.description: a non-empty tv_password is set (from match.assign cvars, the console or the command line); null = unknown. Never the value

settings.description: the effective profile (server settings, then the match's rules.broadcast and tv.set {scope: match} on top)

delay_floor.description: the loaded match's own minimum tv_delay; 0 = none

casters.description: how many casters may join the game port as spectators (count only)

server_insecure.description: the server process itself runs -insecure (not VAC-secured)
